lessonRef.title: Concept model C: using congruence and similarity criteria in proofs

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example is written more briefly. Fill in the reasoning it leaves out.

items.prompt: AB = 4 maps to DE = 12, BC = 5. Find EF.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 3 and 48. Find the altitude.
A 8 m pole casts a 6 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 42 m shadow. How tall is the building?
Two triangles with all three pairs of sides in the same ratio are similar. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: This is the SSS congruence criterion applied directly.
The criterion holds only when the ratio is a whole number.
This is the SSS similarity criterion: a dilation matches one triangle’s sides to the other’s, and the resulting figures are congruent.
Equal ratios of sides guarantee congruence, not similarity.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 2 corresponds to DE = 6. If BC = 10, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 2 and 8. Find the altitude.
A 6 m pole casts a 6 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 30 m shadow. How tall is the building?
The Pythagorean theorem can be proved using similarity. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The theorem follows because all right triangles are similar to each other.
Similarity gives a² + b² = c² only for isosceles right triangles.
The theorem follows from the triangle inequality.
The altitude to the hypotenuse creates two triangles similar to the original; writing both similarity proportions and adding them yields a² + b² = c².

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 2 corresponds to DE = 8. If BC = 6, find EF.
